facts.fact: PeeringDB's record, last updated 2026-05-13, lists the Lesotho Internet Exchange Point (LIXP) in Maseru, run by the Internet Exchange Point Association of Lesotho, with 3 peers, 3 connections, all open-policy, and 30G total declared capacity; Econet Telecom Lesotho is one of the peers.
